summary: 200 rows desk-checked; all 200 home pages fetched directly (status, redirect target, page title, city/postal match) and ~60 web search/fetch calls on flagged rows (search budget then exhausted). Main issues: 9 acquisitions/renames shown by site redirects (CloudKettle->Ateko, Bitstrapped->TELUS Digital, Logient+nventive->Wepoint, Thinkmax->Talan, WebSan->Rand Group, XRM Vision->Alithya, Softlanding & Groupe Access->MSP Corp, Difenda->Quorum Cyber, Dynamix->F12); duplicates (Converge=Pellera, Myplanet=Orium, Private AI=Limina, XRM Vision=Alithya, nventive=Logient, Digital Echidna=Northern Commerce, plus Ada and Spellbook duplicated in slices D/E); dead/wrong sites (FCV parked for sale, Digital Echidna parked, Pragmatica URL is a VR speech-therapy product, Nubik/CentML down); not Canadian (Pellera HQ Tallahassee, Tenstorrent Santa Clara, Resemble AI California, Bastian/Toyota US, Softchoice/WWT, TrojAI/A10, Wysdom/Calabrio); Hopper and several deep-tech/biotech rows proposed for removal; ~21 aidev product companies regrouped to ai/acct/clinic/sec/vert/lms/mkt/bi.
